info.title: spm
info.description: spm (Skill and Plugin Manager) — a CLI, interactive REPL, and MCP server that installs AI agent skills from Git catalogs into every coding agent on your machine, following the open agent-skills conventions: one shared .agents/skills copy plus a link per agent. Find a skill by intent with ranked search, deploy it across every detected agent at once, keep deployments healthy with doctor/cleanup, or run spm as an MCP server so an agent can search and install skills itself.

commands.description:

commands.name: cleanup
commands.description:
Clean stale spm artifacts — broken links, staging leftovers, stale
clones, lost records. Preview by default; --apply to perform,
folders go to quarantine

commands.name: install
commands.description:
Deploy a skill to every detected AI agent — from your catalogs or
straight from a GitHub repo (org/repo)
Aliases:  i

options.name: --skills
options.description:
Comma-separated skill names to install from a GitHub repo
(skips the picker)

options.name: --agents
options.description:
Comma-separated agent keys to deploy to, e.g.
claude-code,windsurf (skips the agent picker; see `spm
agents`)

options.name: --catalog
options.description: update to pin a skill's source)

options.name: --project
options.description:
Deploy only into the current project, even if you'd
normally be asked [default: False]

options.name: --global
options.description:
Deploy only to global agent configs, even when run inside
a project [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description:
Deploy to both scopes: this project and global agent
configs [default: False]

options.name: --copy
options.description:
Copy the skill into every agent folder instead of linking
them to the shared .agents/skills copy [default: False]
